"SNAPPY STRONG"
Day: 28  Monday  10-28-24

Warm Up: Make up your mind and tell
yourself that you're gonna move
the weights Fast and SNAPPY today.

1. a. Snappy BACK Squat 5 sets of 2 reps
super        @ 70%
set  b. Slow Strict Chin Ups 5 sets of 3-6 reps
   2 min rest between each superset

2. a. BENCH PRESS 5 sets of 3 reps @ 70%
                                        "Be Snappy"
super
set  b. 1 Arm DB Rows 5 sets of 5 reps
   2 min rest between each superset

Cardio                           Recovery
                                 Meat loaf
a. Ez Bar/or BB Skullcrushers    Green Beans
             3x 15 reps          Mac & Cheese
super                             30 min Walk
set b. KB Swings 3x 10 reps      Heavy Sleep
   60 sec rest between each
         super set

* This session should take 30-35 minutes
